friendly_name: Model-task routing: the catalog kind and the advisory recommendation
purpose_context: Cutover read R14 (#108). The catalog moves from core into a pack as an artifact kind with layering, policy and activation, and the service answers an advisory recommendation for a task type, agent profile and optional mission step under an activation, per the operator rulings of 2026-11-18. A build ADR decides the shape first.
purpose_tldr: Serve the model-task routing catalog as a pack artifact kind and recommend a model for a task under an activation.
